field.name: terms
field.p: Your premium. Annual, per person, by age next birthday; paid in full before cover starts.
Who can join. From 1 month to 75 (last joining age 75). A medical report for everyone joining at 55 and over. Renewal depends on claims and APA's underwriting.

Waiting periods. Accidents: none. Illness: 30 days. Surgery: 90 days. Pre-existing, chronic and congenital conditions, HIV/AIDS, fibroids, hernia, adenoids and haemorrhoids: 12 months. Maternity: 10 months. Cataract: 1 year (APA's exclusions say 24 months). Transplants: 3rd year. A break in cover restarts them.

Before treatment. APA's panel only: no refund for treatment elsewhere. Show your card. Planned admissions: tell APA 48 hours ahead and wait for approval; emergencies within 48 hours. Bills are paid net of SHIF. Cover: Kenya, and up to 6 weeks abroad on a refund.

Not covered. Check-ups, cosmetic surgery unless after an accident, family planning and infertility, alternative medicine, self-injury, drink and drugs, war, glasses and dental unless in the cover, treatment outside Kenya or the panel, and APA's other exclusions.
How to pay. Pay APA directly: NCBA Bank account 6447560039 (Westlands) or M-Pesa Paybill 511600, account: the principal's name (renewals: policy number). Keep APA's receipt.

Please note. This is a quotation, not cover: cover starts once APA accepts the application and has the full premium. Declare all health conditions, or claims can be refused and cover cancelled. Either side may cancel on 14 days' notice; no refund after 6 months or once a claim is made. APA's policy document prevails over this summary.
